records.title: 10-Q
records.text: Net sales increased $186.4 million, or 13.0%, to $1,625.6 million in the first quarter of 2021, compared to $1,439.1 million in the first quarter of 2020.

records.title: 10-Q
records.text: •Comparable sales for stores open at least fifteen months, plus our e-commerce operations, increased $159.3 million, or 11.3%.

records.title: 10-Q
records.text: •Inventory increased by 11.8% or $94.9 million to $901.5 million from the first quarter of 2020.

records.title: 10-Q
records.text: •Gross margin dollars increased $83.2 million, while gross margin rate increased 50 basis points to 40.2% of sales.

records.title: 10-Q
records.text: •Operating profit rate increased 230 basis points to 7.5%.
